title: Starlight Double-Blind Reviewer Output
description: Output contract for a single blind reviewer (Claude or Codex). Two such outputs are produced independently, then a third Jury agent reads both to produce a final product-review.json. The mandatory 3-blocker floor is intentional: a reviewer that finds zero blockers on a non-shipped video is automatically considered derelict (per memory:feedback_validator_pass_not_product_pass).

reviewerId.description: Which model produced this review. The Jury uses this to weigh dimension-specific trust (Claude on narrative/childAppeal, Codex on schema/timing-window conflicts).

buildId.description: Matches the build directory under tools/recognition-video/builds/.

input.description: Exact files the reviewer was given. Allows the Jury to verify both reviewers saw the same 5-piece input pack.

scores.description: 11-dimension scores mirroring product-review.schema.json. Each score requires a one-line reason so the Jury can audit reasoning rather than just numbers.

blockers.description: Mandatory floor of 3. A reviewer that cannot find 3 issues on a non-shipped build is dismissing the job; the orchestrator should re-run the review with a stricter system prompt.

atTime.description: Seconds into the video where the issue is visible, or null if it is a structural/cross-frame issue.

atKeyframe.description: Filename of the keyframe snapshot evidencing the issue, or null.

issue.description: What is wrong (observable). No hand-wavy adjectives — describe what is on screen.

rootCause.description: First-principles diagnosis of why it is wrong. Must point to a brief/spec/animation choice, not a polish item.

specRef.description: Optional pointer to the spec/brief field that is at fault.

strengths.description: Optional. Worth noting only if they are non-obvious; this field is not a politeness slot.

confidence.description: Self-rated confidence in the verdict. Low means the Jury should weight this review less or request a second pass.

rationale.description: Plain-language summary of the overall verdict. Forces the reviewer to state a coherent narrative, not just a score sheet.

reason.description: One-line justification for the score on this dimension.
